title: F2: Fun and Frustration
desc: Two young men hope to control their wives after their respective marriages. However, their chauvinistic attitude often lands them in hilarious situations.

title: Dashavtara
desc: Angered by Lord Vishnu's act of slaughtering a woman in battle, the venerated sage Bhigu curses the Lord, forcing Him to take countless avatars and atone for His sins.

title: Buddhivantha
desc: Skilled in impersonating numerous characters, Panchamrutha is a flamboyant womaniser. He vows to target and expose women who are egoistic about their beauty and wealth.

desc: A junior artist named Anila is roped into a plan to bring together a broken family. However, he stumbles upon a powerful secret of theirs that involves black magic and the supernatural.

title: Ganesha Mathe Banda
desc: When Ganesha gets married to a woman who has a differing outlook on marriage, their ideologies of tradition and modernism clash.

title: Yamanige Ganda
desc: An error grants Naresh eternal life, prompting him to assist deities in numerous missions. However, when he develops feelings for Lord Yama's daughter, he incurs the wrath of the death god.

title: Aramane
desc: A photographer named Arun befriends Rajashekhara, a wealthy but lonely man who has resorted to drinking to quell his pain. Soon, Arun agrees to help him reunite with his estranged family.
